note: Reviewed exceptions to extraction/wrapper_gate.py. Each entry excuses exactly one (template, section) gate error; the gate still warns on it, fails if the entry no longer matches an error (stale) or if the measured height exceeds maxHeightPx (over cap). reviewedBy names who reviewed it; an agent review is an agent attestation, never a human sign-off.

entries.reviewedBy: Claude (design-repo extraction agent) -- agent attestation, not a human sign-off
entries.justification: index.events-past is the past-events archive: one filterable grid of 52 repeated event cards (src/components/sections/EventsFilter.jsx:20 DEFAULT_ITEMS length 52). It is an index listing, not a whole-page wrapper or an article; its height scales with the number of archived events, so it legitimately holds most of /resources/events-webinars (79% at 1440px). Splitting it would cut one listing into arbitrary chunks.
